name: 52 - Core - Deterministic Safety Gate - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $3::NUMERIC AS confidence_threshold
),

route_context AS (
    SELECT
        session.id AS session_id,
        session.clinic_id,
        session.patient_id,
        session.channel,
        session.external_conversation_id,
        session.language AS session_language,
        session.status AS session_status,
        session.last_intent,
        session.pending_action,
        session.collected_entities,
        session.risk_flags AS session_risk_flags,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        message.id AS message_id,
        message.content_text,
        message.content_json,
        message.intent,
        message.intent_confidence,
        message.extracted_entities,
        message.risk_flags AS message_risk_flags,
        message.tool_action AS proposed_tool_action,

        ai_run.id AS ai_run_id,
        ai_run.parsed_output AS ai_output,

        request.confidence_threshold

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN conversation_sessions session
        ON session.id = request.session_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = session.clinic_id

    LEFT JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = session.patient_id

    INNER JOIN conversation_messages message
        ON message.id = request.message_id
       AND message.session_id = session.id
       AND message.direction = 'inbound'

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            run.id,
            run.parsed_output
        FROM conversation_ai_runs run
        WHERE run.session_id = session.id
          AND run.input_message_id = message.id
          AND run.status = 'success'
        ORDER BY
            run.created_at DESC,
            run.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) ai_run
        ON TRUE

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM route_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM route_context
            WHERE ai_output IS NULL
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM route_context
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM route_context
            WHERE ai_output IS NULL
        )
            THEN 'ai_route_not_found'

        ELSE 'safety_context_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(route_context)
        FROM route_context
    ) AS safety_context

FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $3::TEXT AS safety_decision,
        $4::TEXT AS proposed_tool_action,
        $5::TEXT AS safe_tool_action,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS block_reason,
        $7::JSONB AS risk_flags,
        $8::JSONB AS safety_payload,
        $9::TEXT AS session_status,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, '') AS pending_action
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE conversation_messages message

    SET
        risk_flags = request.risk_flags,
        tool_action = request.safe_tool_action,

        tool_result =
            COALESCE(
                message.tool_result,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'safety',
                request.safety_payload
            )

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE message.id = request.message_id
      AND message.session_id = request.session_id

    RETURNING message.id
),

updated_session AS (
    UPDATE conversation_sessions session

    SET
        status = request.session_status,
        pending_action = request.pending_action,
        risk_flags = request.risk_flags,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE session.id = request.session_id

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM updated_message
      )

    RETURNING session.id, session.status, session.pending_action
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN request.safety_decision =
             'urgent_handoff'
            THEN 'urgent_safety_handoff_required'

        WHEN request.safety_decision IN (
            'human_handoff',
            'allow_with_human_review'
        )
            THEN 'human_review_required'

        WHEN request.safety_decision IN (
            'ask_clarification',
            'ask_missing_information',
            'request_confirmation'
        )
            THEN 'patient_input_required'

        ELSE 'safety_gate_passed'
    END AS result,

    request.session_id,
    request.message_id,
    request.safety_decision,
    request.proposed_tool_action,
    request.safe_tool_action,
    request.block_reason,
    request.risk_flags,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS pending_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## لایه ایمنی قطعی

این Workflow بعد از شماره 51 اجرا می‌شود و تصمیم مدل را بدون استفاده مجدد از AI بررسی می‌کند.

قواعد اصلی:
- علائم فوری → ارجاع فوری
- اطمینان پایین → سؤال روشن‌کننده
- اطلاعات ناقص → درخواست اطلاعات
- عملیات نوشتنی → تأیید صریح بیمار
- نگرانی حریم خصوصی → ارجاع انسانی

فقط session_id و message_id لازم است؛ سایر اطلاعات از PostgreSQL خوانده می‌شوند.
